# Kling Omni API

> Create and edit videos with image and video references.

Create and edit videos with image and video references.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [First last frame](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-omni/first-last-frame.md) | `POST /kling-video/omni/first-last-frame` |
| [Image reference](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-omni/image-reference.md) | `POST /kling-video/omni/image-reference` |
| [Video edit](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-omni/video-edit.md) | `POST /kling-video/omni/video-edit` |
| [Video reference](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/kling-omni/video-reference.md) | `POST /kling-video/omni/video-reference` |

Open a workflow to see its complete input schema, required fields, supported values and request examples.
